title: Segmented entitlement & contract flow: observability retention, compliance pack, and premium SLA experiments
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Experiment to validate segmented entitlement flows and contract gating for three paid add-ons: (1) Observability retention tiers (30/90/365 days), (2) Compliance Pack (security questionnaire + attestation + audit logs), and (3) Premium SLA (SLA upgrade with response/latency windows). Purpose: measure lift in conversion, ARR, and operational load while keeping friction for self-serve users low.

We will implement feature flags and entitlement checks in the Console and billing API, and integrate the enterprise security questionnaire as an optional gating step that can be used to auto-provision Compliance Pack entitlements after review. The experiment has two dimensions: pricing structure (monthly add-on vs. overage) and gating mechanism (self-serve toggle vs. contract+questionnaire).
acceptance_criteria:
1) End-to-end flow for purchasing each addon exists in Console and via API (feature-flagged).
2) Instrumentation emits events: addon_viewed, addon_started_checkout, addon_purchased, questionnaire_submitted, questionnaire_approved, sla_activated.
3) Dashboards show conversion funnel and MRR delta by cohort (trial, self-serve paid, enterprise sales-assisted).
4) Security team signs off on questionnaire gating language and data retention controls.
5) Legal/Contracts team approves the compliance pack contract language and billing triggers.
6) No regression in onboarding latency or billing reliability for Dedicated customers.
7) Experiment runbook and rollback prepared and validated by SRE/Console owners.
notes:
Trade-offs discussed:
- Self-serve long-retention tier increases storage costs; offset with higher unit price and conditional availability for non-burst workloads.
- Compliance Pack requires minimal manual review for first 30 customers to tune questionnaire heuristics; can escalate to Contract Ops for complex requests.
- Premium SLA will be presented as an 'upgrade' route for dedicated/reserved customers only in initial pilot.

Metrics of interest: conversion rate, ARPA change, incremental MRR, CSAT for new purchases, number of manual contract reviews, time-to-provision for Compliance Pack.
